title: Special Executive Programme In Industrial and Intellectual Property Law
description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of intellectual property law, its types, and enforcement across jurisdictions.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme explains the concept and evolution of intellectual property law and the rationale behind intellectual property rules and regulations. The course provides insight into different types of intellectual property while exploring the relationship between these legal mechanisms and other fundamental rights. The course presents an in-depth and detailed analysis of rules relating to confidential information as one of the most controversial elements in business negotiations.
courseDetails: The course begins with an overview of the evolution of intellectual property law and its relationship with public interest. Participants will explore various types of IP, including copyrights, trademarks, and patents, along with their legal frameworks. The programme covers issues related to breaches of confidential information, the enforcement of IP rights, and available civil remedies. It concludes with an analysis of IP rights violations and remedies under both UK and US legal systems, while considering the impact of Brexit.
